qwen2.5:3b.note: Licence is the Qwen Research License (the 3B is the exception to Qwen2.5's Apache 2.0), which allows research and non-commercial use only.

gemma4:e2b-it-qat.note: Fine-tune base: unsloth/gemma-4-E2B-it (Apache 2.0); the Ollama tag is a QAT build of it. The guide's only T4 caveat (an fp16 overflow) is about the audio path.
